bio.p1: Systems engineer with 13+ years of experience building web and desktop applications on the .NET platform. I specialize in cloud architecture with AWS and modern interfaces with React. I have led development teams and built products from scratch as a co-founder of Grodivo.
bio.p2: I am currently completing an artificial intelligence specialization at TEC de Monterrey, combining years of software engineering with AI tooling. I care about clean architecture, microservices, and scalable systems that solve real business problems.
bio.p3: Outside of work I mentor junior developers, take part in tech communities, and lead the Hatch-Futures Peru growth initiative. In my spare time I am building DevMan, a platformer in the style of the 16-bit classics.
